SHARED-F-2-S70.title: Consent Data Schema and Contract Definition
SHARED-F-2-S70.description: Define and implement persistent data schema and Pydantic contracts for consent records, including tier designation, timestamping, user/session linkage, and audit fields required for HIPAA compliance.

SHARED-F-2-S71.title: Consent API Endpoints and Tool Integration
SHARED-F-2-S71.description: Expose consent capture and retrieval via FastAPI endpoints and integrate with tool_router to allow LLM-driven workflows to trigger consent requests and read consent state safely.

SHARED-F-2-S72.title: Cross-Service Consent Enforcement Integration
SHARED-F-2-S72.description: Integrate consent enforcement across dependent services (lead capture, unknown questions, debug logging) ensuring all data storage and processing paths respect Tier 1 and Tier 2 constraints.
